summary.text: Andrea Verobish is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 79, who won a March 17, 2026 special election and took office on April 13, 2026; she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot against Democrat Caleb McCoy.
She previously worked as a field representative and economic development specialist for U.S. Representative Glenn Thompson and as a legislative aide to State Senator John Eichelberger.

paragraphs.text: Verobish earned a high school diploma from Hollidaysburg Area Senior High School in 2006, followed by a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in public administration, both from Gannon University.

Her career also includes work as a constituent services representative for Thompson, an income maintenance caseworker, main street manager for the Borough of Hollidaysburg, data management assistant and AmeriCorps representative.
Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as the Pennsylvania Rural Arts Alliance, the Hollidaysburg Area Women's Club and the Blair County Republican Committee.
